interpretation: The release driver, including nondefault registrations and every grouped child, is the inventory authority.
Eligibility is the licence/exclusion audit result, not a claim that a port exists or has passed nts.
Required input data is audited separately from wrappers and bundled libraries. An umbrella notice never overrides a component-specific licence.

Compiled-to-JavaScript excludes cross-language generated programs such as scheme2js/Mandreel, asm.js, and Wasm; authored JavaScript/TypeScript library distribution bundles are audited for their actual workload.
Tokens inside parser/JSON inputs are inert data. Dormant host loaders are distinguished from active measured eval, Proxy, workers and browser dependencies.
The released web-ssr row times cache-busted eval and is excluded even though the driver omits a startup tag. A rendering-only variant requires a separate scope decision.
Plain raytrace is covered already. Its explicit public/private-class-field variants retain separate feature coverage, with the unchanged scene and original validation.

WSL retains the original Proxy test registry: one construction and 285 set traps during static registration, none during work. Its original validation and ordering are unchanged; compiler/evaluator work uses no Proxy.

Approved timing policy: retain complete original inputs; if one full iteration at seed = 1 exceeds 10 ms under Node 24.20.0, document the timing exception in the PR and case README instead of shrinking the input.

The six genuine async workloads are included as draft ports with work(n): Promise<number>. Maintainers will add awaited execution/checksum support and mark them ready after it lands; the synchronous harness is not modified here.

The original 43-row selection is retained for historical accounting. Full implementation review newly blocks babel-wtb: six exact caniuse-lite 1.0.30001731 modules carry a package-level CC-BY-4.0 grant outside the permitted list; no separate permitted grant was found. Current licence-cleared candidates number 42. See babel-license-finding.md and babel-caniuse-license-audit.json.
